_meta.//: SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR EVERY OTHER LANGUAGE. Every key that exists here must exist in every other file in this directory, with the same placeholders in it - scripts/i18nprobe.ts fails the build otherwise. The English values are also load-bearing in another way: forty browser harnesses select elements by their visible text, so changing a string here is changing a test selector.

squad.statusFringeDesc: He has been told where he stands. He expects nothing and may want out.

tactics.sliderStyleUp: Wide attacking rugby: backs see more ball (attack ↑), but you concede scrum solidity and some breakdown muscle.
tactics.sliderStyleDown: Tight, forward-first rugby: stronger scrum and maul platform, fewer strike chances out wide.
tactics.sliderTempoUp: Quick taps and fast rucks: more attacking punch, but your players burn energy faster and the defence loosens.
tactics.sliderTempoDown: Measured phase play: saves the legs and keeps defensive shape, at the cost of attacking spark.
tactics.sliderKickingUp: Territory game: contestable kicks and corner pins, and your kicking unit matters more. Great in bad weather. You carry less, so attack and breakdown both drop.
tactics.sliderKickingDown: Keep it in hand: more running threat and more ruck presence, but you live in your own half if it goes wrong.
tactics.sliderAggressionUp: Fly into rucks and dominate collisions: breakdown power up, more yellows, and a lot more kickable penalties. Check the referee first - a fussy whistle punishes this hard, a lenient one lets you away with it.
tactics.sliderAggressionDown: Discipline first: fewer penalties and cards, less breakdown menace. The safe call against a referee who is strict at the tackle.
tactics.sliderDefLineUp: Fly off the line: harder tackles and turnovers (defence ↑), but offside pings and cards climb with it.
tactics.sliderDefLineDown: Drift and contain: cleaner discipline, but you give their attack time and space to work.
tactics.sliderDefWidthUp: String the line to the touchlines: smothers a wide attack, but a tight pick-and-go side runs through the middle.
tactics.sliderDefWidthDown: Pack the fringes: shuts down a forward-first side, but a wide attack finds grass out there.
tactics.presetAlloutDesc: Everything wide and fast. Chasing a score - shape be damned.
tactics.presetShutupDesc: Protect the lead. Slow it down, keep shape, kick the pressure away.
tactics.presetCornersDesc: Territory war: pin them deep and squeeze penalties from their exits.
tactics.presetTightDesc: Ten-man rugby. Maul it, carry hard, strangle the game up front.
tactics.presetBalancedDesc: Take what the defence gives you. No extremes.
tactics.styleBalancedDesc: Pragmatism above all - pick the right tool each week.
tactics.styleForwardsDesc: Win the collisions, win the game. Scrum, maul, squeeze.
tactics.styleExpansiveDesc: Width, offloads and heads-up rugby in the Fiji tradition.
tactics.styleTerritoryDesc: The classic ten-man kicking game: field position is everything.
tactics.styleHightempoDesc: Play at a pace nobody can live with - fitness is a weapon.
tactics.styleDefensiveDesc: Blitz defence and discipline. Keep them to nil and nick it.
tactics.styleCounterDesc: Soak pressure, strike from broken field. Turnover = try.
tactics.styleOffloadDesc: Keep the ball alive through contact - high risk, box office.

roles.scrummagerDesc: Lives for the set piece. Scrum up, a touch less around the park.
roles.mobileDesc: A front-rower with wheels. Attack up, scrum eases off.
roles.throwerDesc: The throw is his job and he drills it. Lineout up, scrum eases.
roles.linkDesc: A hooker who plays like a flanker. Attack and breakdown up, scrum eases.
roles.lineout_generalDesc: Runs the air. Lineout up, and his eyes are up there rather than on the floor.
roles.enforcer_lockDesc: Brings the nasty. Breakdown up, cards flirt.
roles.jackal_roleDesc: First to every ruck. Breakdown up, but he is over the ball rather than in the line.
roles.carrierDesc: Hard metres every time. Attack up; carrying is not clearing rucks.
roles.stopperDesc: Tackles everything that moves. Defence up, attack eases.
roles.box_kickerDesc: Pins the corners. Kicking game up, less ball through the hands.
roles.sniperDesc: Darts from the base. Attack up, kicking eases.
roles.kicking_generalDesc: Plays the corners all day. Kicking well up.
roles.playmakerDesc: Flat to the line, ball in hand. Attack up, defence eases.
roles.crashDesc: Over the gain line. Breakdown support up, a little less width.
roles.distributorDesc: Hands through the gap. Attack up, defence eases.
roles.finisherDesc: Feed him and he scores. Attack edge up, defence eases.
roles.aerialDesc: Owns the high ball. Defence and kick-chase up, less of a threat with it in hand.

playbook.lo_frontDesc: Safe throw to two. Almost never lost, almost never a weapon.
playbook.lo_middleDesc: The orthodox call. Nothing to exploit, nothing to fear.
playbook.lo_backDesc: Throw to the tail and go. High reward, and a steal if the timing slips.
playbook.lo_dummyDesc: Sell the front, deliver at the back. Hard to read, hard to drill.
playbook.lo_maulDesc: Catch and drive. The best attacking lineout there is, and the slowest.
playbook.lo_topDesc: Tapped straight down for fast ball. Quick hands, no platform.
playbook.sc_channel1Desc: Ball out fast past the hooker. Quick, and no shove behind it.
playbook.sc_holdDesc: Stable platform, ball at the eight's feet. The default for a reason.
playbook.sc_shoveDesc: Go after them. Penalties if you win it, a mess if you do not.
playbook.sc_wheelDesc: Turn the scrum and break off the side. Technical and deniable.

bench.split53Desc: The orthodox bench. Cover everywhere, a weapon nowhere.
bench.split62Desc: The bomb squad. You win the last twenty up front, and one back injury leaves a forward in the backline.
bench.split44Desc: Width and insurance. Fresh legs out wide and cover for every back, at the cost of the shove.
bench.briefOrdersDesc: Do the job the man you replaced was doing. No change of plan.
bench.briefImpactDesc: Twenty minutes flat out. More carry, less cover, and he will be empty at the end.
bench.briefShoreDesc: Tackles, discipline, no risks. The lead is the only thing that matters.
bench.briefManageDesc: Kick the clock away and keep it in their half. Nothing fancy.

analyst.noMatchToStudy: No match this week, so nothing to study. He will have a read on the next opponent as soon as one is in the diary.
analyst.noReadsYet: No reads followed yet this era.
analyst.followedReads: Followed {n} of his reads: right {right}, wrong {wrong}.
analyst.weekIsHis: The week is his. If he has read them right you will feel it in that area on Saturday.
analyst.ignoreHim: Ignore him and prepare as you see fit - he is wrong often enough to argue with.
analyst.sureStake: I would stake my job on this
analyst.sureHunch: It is a hunch, but a decent one
analyst.andTest: , and {name} is the one to test
analyst.weakScrum: their scrum goes backwards under pressure
analyst.weakLineout: their lineout is a lottery beyond the front pod
analyst.weakDefence: their defensive line comes up in ones and twos
analyst.weakAttack: they have no shape once the first phase breaks down
analyst.weakKicking: their kicking game hands territory back every time
analyst.howScrum: Live scrummaging all week. Squeeze them and the penalties come.
analyst.howLineout: Set-piece work: contest their throw and the platform collapses.
analyst.howDefence: Attacking shapes. Move them side to side and holes appear.
analyst.howKicking: Attacking shapes and quick counters off their loose kicks.
analyst.howAttack: Defensive drills. Squeeze the space and let them run out of ideas.

philosophy.packBlurb: They want a shoving match. Maul off the lineout, pick and go, squeeze at the scrum.
philosophy.packSoft: Slow their ball down and the width outside them is decoration.
philosophy.widthBlurb: Ball to the edges early and often, with the offload always on in contact.
philosophy.widthSoft: Front up in the collisions and their handling starts costing them.
philosophy.tempoBlurb: Tap and go, quick rucks, no time to reset. They want you out of breath by fifty.
philosophy.tempoSoft: Keep your shape for an hour and the pace they set is the pace they die at.
philosophy.squeezeBlurb: Field position first. Long kicks, corner pins, and pressure on your exits.
philosophy.squeezeSoft: Beat the first chaser and there is acres behind their kicking game.
philosophy.blitzBlurb: Up and at you off the line, then kick the turnover long. Built to strangle.
philosophy.blitzSoft: Go behind the rush rather than into it and the line is stretched thin.
philosophy.counterBlurb: Happy without the ball. They soak it up and strike the moment it breaks loose.
philosophy.counterSoft: Hold on to it, build phases, and give them nothing to run at.
philosophy.chaosBlurb: Fast, physical and loose on purpose. They back themselves in a scramble.
philosophy.chaosSoft: Discipline. They give away more than they win when it gets messy.
philosophy.structureBlurb: Patient phase play off a set plan, and they will not hand you penalties.
philosophy.structureSoft: Force them off script early. Improvising is not what they practise.
philosophy.counter_pack: Meet them up front. Go wide off slow ball against that pack and they will eat you at the breakdown.
philosophy.counter_width: Pin them in their own half and make them play from deep, where all that width costs them more than it gains.
philosophy.counter_tempo: Slow it down. Every reset is a breather you take and they do not want.
philosophy.counter_squeeze: Run it back at them. A side that lives on field position hates chasing.
philosophy.counter_blitz: Go round the rush rather than into it, and keep the penalty count clean so they get no easy exits.
philosophy.counter_counter: Give them nothing loose. Build phases and kick only when the chase is set.
philosophy.counter_chaos: Be the disciplined side and let them give it away. Do not join the scrap.
philosophy.counter_structure: Rush them off their script early. Speed and pressure beat a plan they have rehearsed all week.

tacticsScreen.condCoach: The conditioning coach wants a word
tacticsScreen.condLine: {n} weeks running at the same extreme on {dial}. The GPS numbers say the squad is running {pct}% hotter than it should, and the last twenty minutes are where you feel that. The league reads a manager who repeats himself, too. Two weeks nearer the middle walks both back.
tacticsScreen.roleSheetSub: No. {shirt} · how should he play the position? · {n} options
tacticsScreen.rolesNote: Tap a shirt to set his role or open his profile. Roles are small, honest edges - the scrummager props up the set piece, the playmaker opens the game.
tacticsScreen.setPieceRuleRest: Whatever you call gets sharper every week and everything else goes rusty, so pick moves you mean to keep calling. Set-Piece Work in Prep speeds it up and your scrum coach sets the ceiling.
tacticsScreen.kickerNote: First choice takes everything; the second man steps up when he is off.
tacticsScreen.exitBoxDesc: Safest way out, and it hands the ball back.
tacticsScreen.exitLongDesc: Field position first. Solid and hard to punish.
tacticsScreen.exitCounterDesc: You keep the ball and take the risk in your own half.
tacticsScreen.exitFifty22Desc: Huge if the boot is accurate, a gift if it is not.
tacticsScreen.penAskDesc: You get asked every time. Fine for a big game, tiring on a wet Friday.
tacticsScreen.penPostsDesc: Three points, every time. No drama and no big scores.
tacticsScreen.penCornerDesc: Back the maul. Tries win knockouts.
tacticsScreen.penTapDesc: Play before they set. Chaos, in both directions.
tacticsScreen.noFrontRow: No front-row cover on the bench.
tacticsScreen.law3: Law 3 says the scrum goes uncontested if either side cannot cover hooker and both props, and both teams lose the weapon. The 16, 17 and 18 shirts exist for exactly this.
tacticsScreen.splitMismatch: You named a {want}, and the men in the shirts make it a {got}. The bench you actually pick is the one that plays.
tacticsScreen.the23Sub: the first three shirts cover the front row - the rest is yours
tacticsScreen.finisherBriefsSub: the first three briefs to come on are the ones that land
tacticsScreen.matchPrepSub: an edge next week, always with a cost
tacticsScreen.prepRecoveryShort: Squad regains extra fitness this week
tacticsScreen.prepAttackLong: The week is spent on strike moves and width. Attack +3.5%, defence −1%.
tacticsScreen.prepDefenceLong: Wall-building: line speed, spacing, scramble. Defence +3.5%, attack −1%.
tacticsScreen.prepSetpieceLong: Live scrummaging and lineout reps. Scrum & lineout +4%, attack −1%.
tacticsScreen.prepFitnessLong: Lung-busters. Your players tire ~8% slower in the next match.
tacticsScreen.prepRecoveryLong: Feet up, pool sessions, massage. Everyone recovers extra condition this week.
tacticsScreen.prepNone: No focus set this week - training runs on autopilot. Pick one above; every choice trades something away.
tacticsScreen.quickGamePlansSub: one tap sets all four sliders
tacticsScreen.withTheBallSub: how you attack when your fifteen have the ball
tacticsScreen.withoutTheBallSub: how the line defends when they have it

staff.roleAssistantDesc: Sharper sessions - bigger training gains, faster youth growth, better auto-picked sides.
staff.rolePhysioDesc: Shorter injury layoffs and quicker recovery between matches.
staff.roleScoutDesc: Faster, wider scouting knowledge across the leagues.
staff.roleAttackDesc: Strike moves and shape - a sharper attack every matchday, bigger attacking training gains.
staff.roleDefenceDesc: Line speed and system - a meaner defence every matchday, bigger defensive training gains.
staff.roleScrumCoachDesc: Scrum and lineout platform - the tight five win you matchday penalties.
staff.roleKickingDesc: Territory and the tee - better tactical kicking and goal kicking under pressure.
staff.roleAcademyCoachDesc: Runs the second squad - academy prospects develop faster under a proper mentor.
staff.clickNumbers: two numbers men who finish each other's spreadsheets
staff.clickRoom: the dressing room has never hummed like this
staff.clickScrum: one programme, built entirely of scrummaging
staff.clickCaps: the kids listen harder when the man pointing has caps
staff.clashGps: GPS vests against hill runs, daily
staff.clashLaptop: the laptop and the caps disagree about everything
staff.clashVideo: the video sessions are killing the mood in the room
staff.blockNoClubLong: You have no club to appoint him to.
staff.blockBiggerClubLong: {name} thanked you for the call and stayed where he is. A {badge}-badge coach wants a bigger stage than this.
staff.blockNoBudget: No budget - you have {have} of the {need}
staff.blockNoBudgetLong: {name} would come, but his club want {need} compensation and there is {have} in the bank. Sell somebody, or wait for the gate money.
staff.courseNoClubLong: You have no club to send anybody on a course.
staff.courseGoldLong: {name} already holds his gold badge. There is nothing left to sit.
staff.courseSittingLong: {name} is already on a course. The examiners will not be hurried.
staff.courseResitsLong: {name} cannot sit it again yet - he failed recently and the next intake is {n} weeks off.
staff.courseResitsLongOne: {name} cannot sit it again yet - he failed recently and the next intake is {n} week off.
staff.courseNoBudget: No budget - you have {have} of the {need}
staff.courseNoBudgetLong: The course costs {need} and there is {have} in the bank. The examiners take the fee up front.
staff.candGone: That candidate is no longer available.

training.weeklyFocusSub: small weekly gains in the focus area
training.focusScrumDesc: Live scrums and strength work for the tight five.
training.personalPlansSub: individual programmes - up to {cap}, tap a name to cycle
training.mentoringSub: a senior pro brings an under-{age} through (max 3)
training.infrastructureSub: the ground, the pitch, the gym, the shop
training.infraLink: every facility and the board requests to upgrade them ›
training.backroomStaffSub: a badge is one day of assessment - {pct}% pass, and a failure waits a month
training.roomPulling: A coaching team pulling the same way. Your youngsters feel it.
training.roomDisagrees: This room does not agree with itself, and the development work suffers for it.
training.roomCancels: Strong opinions in both directions, cancelling each other out.
training.onCourse: 🎓 On the {badge} course - result in {n} weeks
training.onCourseOne: 🎓 On the {badge} course - result in {n} week
training.failedRetake: Failed his last assessment - can sit it again in {n} weeks
training.failedRetakeOne: Failed his last assessment - can sit it again in {n} week
training.twoKids: Two kids on his wing: each learns at three-quarter speed, and he will say so.
training.mentorEmpty: A Leader or Professional rubs off on a kid - faster growth, and his character sticks. Character decides how well it takes, so pick the pairing rather than the names. A pairing ends itself when the kid has nothing left to learn.
training.fitWaste: A waste of both their time
training.reasonNever: {sPers} and {kPers} was never going to work.
training.reasonBest: A {sPers} teaching a {kPers}: he could not have picked a better example.
training.reasonPoorTeacher: {senior} is a fine player and an indifferent teacher.
training.reasonNotListening: The kid is not listening as closely as he might.
training.reasonAgeGap: {gap} years between them, and it shows in what they talk about.
training.reasonLeads: {senior} leads by example and the boy has noticed.
training.reasonSteady: Steady enough: extras after training, and the odd word that lands.

transfers.contractSituationsSub: deals running down and demands on the table
transfers.nothingUrgent: Nothing urgent. Every contract runs beyond this season and nobody is agitating for improved terms.
transfers.renewNote: Tap a player to renew from his page. From week 25 an unrenewed man can sign a pre-contract elsewhere and walk for nothing in the summer.
transfers.arrivingSummerSub: pre-contracts agreed - they arrive when the season ends
transfers.assignmentNote: Point the network at one league - its players get watched every week{unassigned}. Shortlisted men are always tracked, with alerts when their situation changes.
transfers.loanMarketSub: borrow a star, parent pays half the wage
transfers.noLoans: No clubs above you are loaning right now.
transfers.noMatches: Nobody in the world matches that. Widen a filter{listedHint}.
transfers.listedHint: - clubs list players as the window nears, so try again later
transfers.nobodyToSend: You have nobody to send. Appoint a chief scout in Training & Coaching, then brief him on a 3, 6 or 9-month search.
transfers.reportsBack: He reports back in about {n} weeks.
transfers.reportsBackOne: He reports back in about {n} week.
transfers.longerTrip: A longer trip sees more rugby: more names, and more of them worth signing. He watches{where} - set the focus league below to narrow it.
transfers.scoutsReportSub: his verdict, in his words - tap a name for the full profile
transfers.scoutReportsSub: every postcard and report the department has filed - tap one to read it again

objectives.youth: Blood the academy: give 6+ starts to players aged 21 or under
objectives.derby: Win a derby: the fans demand local bragging rights
objectives.books: Balance the books: finish the season in the black
objectives.tries: Play with ambition: score 55 league tries this season
objectives.scalp: Take a scalp: beat a side with a far bigger name than yours
objectives.fortress: Make the ground a fortress: win 8 home league games
objectives.boardSurvive: stay clear of the bottom two

finances.weeklyLedgerSub: what lands in the account every week
finances.gateNote: A home match adds about {amount} on the gate, and you have one roughly every third week.
finances.gateNoteNone: Gate receipts land on the weeks you play at home, at £30 a head.
finances.paysItsWay: The club pays its way as things stand.
finances.losesMoney: The club loses money on a blank week, so the gate and player sales have to cover the gap.
finances.askBoard: 💰 Ask the board for transfer funds
finances.boardRemembers: The chairman remembers what you delivered. {amount} added - the favour is spent.
finances.boardBacks: The board backs you: {amount} added to the transfer budget.
finances.boardDeclinesTalk: The board politely declines: "Deliver our objectives first, then we'll talk." Meet season objectives to earn a favour.
finances.boardDeclines: The board politely declines. Earn their confidence first.
finances.moveMoney: 🏦 Move {amount} of the balance into the transfer budget
finances.reserveNote: The board protects {reserve} in the bank (a season of wages plus a float); everything above it is yours to move, {step} at a time.
finances.signedCheaper: Signed when you were worth less. The going rate for this slot is now {rate}/wk.
finances.unsoldRest: This slot is paying nothing. The going rate is {rate}/wk.
finances.dealAdvice: A long deal is safe money and pays under the going rate, because the sponsor is buying certainty off you. A short one pays over the odds and sends you back to the market sooner, which is where a good season is worth something. A clause pays best of all, if you deliver it.
finances.salaryCapSub: Your division's ceiling, and the room left
finances.noCap: This division does not run a salary cap. Your wage budget is the only ceiling.
finances.embargoLine: No signings until the embargo is served.
finances.marqueeSub: {n} men can sit outside the cap. Academy players never count
finances.noMarquee: No marquee players named. Open a player and use the marquee button to take his wage out of the calculation.
finances.squadCoverSub: Under contract, by unit, four seasons out
finances.allCovered: Every unit is covered for the next three summers.
finances.fallShort: Fall short and confidence will suffer. Deliver, and you'll be backed.
finances.onCourseSettled: - on course, settled at the final whistle
finances.boardDelighted: The board is delighted with your work.
finances.boardExpectsBetter: The board expects results to improve.
finances.boardImpatient: The board is losing patience. Win, and quickly.
finances.capEmbargo: Transfer embargo: over the cap two years running
finances.treasuryFloor: The board keeps {reserve} banked - a season of wages plus a float - and the balance cannot dip below it.
finances.treasuryMoved: {step} moved into the transfer budget. The bank stands at {balance}, the budget at {budget}.
finances.slotShirtDesc: The main sponsor. The biggest single cheque in the building, and the one the supporters notice.
finances.slotNamingDesc: Somebody else's name over the gates. Lucrative, and never popular on the terraces.
finances.slotKitDesc: Who makes the shirts. Pays in cash and in replica sales through the club shop.
finances.clauseNone: No performance clause. The money is the money.
finances.clauseTop4: Pays the bonus for as long as you sit in the top four.
finances.clauseEurope: Pays the bonus in any season you are in the Continental Cup.
finances.clauseSilverware: Pays the bonus for a season after you win a trophy.
finances.clauseCrowds: Pays the bonus while the ground averages over 90% full.
finances.slotAlreadySold: The {slot} is already under contract to {sponsor} until the end of {year}. You cannot sell it twice.

club.archAnalystDesc: studies your recent matches and sets up to counter your habits
club.archTinkererDesc: changes the picture from the touchline when the match turns against him
club.archBelieverDesc: trusts his own plan, week in, week out
club.noSilverware: 🏆 No silverware in the book yet. Champions are crowned in May.
club.legendsNote: A man joins the Legends list at 100 appearances here, the honours board fills in every May, and record gates and derby ledgers appear the first time you set one.
club.roomBouncing: 😊 The room is bouncing - keep winning and keep quiet.
club.roomSettled: 🙂 Settled enough. A few individuals need an eye kept on them.
club.roomUneasy: 😐 Uneasy. The card schools have gone quiet and doors close faster.
club.roomMutinous: 😤 Mutinous. Sort the loudest voices before they sort you.
club.nobodyAgitating: Nobody is agitating. Enjoy it - it never lasts.
club.eraRecordsSub: what this era will be remembered for
club.clubLegendVote: 🗽 Club legend - voted by the supporters' trust, forever
club.tryOfSeason: 🏉 Try of the Season so far:
club.riftsSub: two of yours are not speaking - and it is costing you
club.askedAlready: You had them in this week already
club.shutTheDoor: Get them in a room and shut the door
club.riftNote: It comes down to whether these two will do it for you: their mood, their characters, how you stand at the club, and how long it has festered. Fail and the squad knows you tried, which costs more than saying nothing.

traits.The StepInfo: Feet like a dancer - defenders grasp at air. Scores more tries.
traits.Offload KingInfo: Keeps the ball alive through contact. Sharpens the whole attack.
traits.Siege GunInfo: A boot from another postcode - dangerous from anywhere kickable.
traits.MetronomeInfo: Never misses the ones he should make. Raises the kicking floor.
traits.JackalInfo: First over every tackle. More breakdown menace.
traits.EnforcerInfo: Brings the dark arts - muscle at scrum and ruck, and refs know his name.
traits.Big-Game PlayerInfo: Grows three inches in knockouts and derbies.
traits.Hot HeadInfo: One flashpoint from a card, every single week.

scoutStage.0: Unscouted: a name on a team sheet. The numbers below are guesswork.
scoutStage.1: Initial report: a weekend of tape. Broad numbers, nothing behind them.
scoutStage.2: Detailed report: strengths and role are clear. Character still unknown.
scoutStage.3: Full file: numbers, character and temperament all verified.

player.gone: Player no longer in the game world (retired or released).
player.overallTitle: his overall standard out of 100, and the one number that decides most matches
player.characterTitle: how he behaves: it drives contract talks, team talks and whether he mentors well
player.characterUnknownTitle: Who a man is takes the longest to scout - the full file reveals it
player.valueTitle: what the market says he is worth, not what a club would accept
player.wageTitle: what he costs you every week of the year
player.contractToTitle: the summer his deal runs out. Leave it too late and he can sign elsewhere for nothing
player.transferRequestTitle: he asked to leave over game time - pick him and he may withdraw it
player.moraleTitle: how happy he is here. Unhappy men play worse and ask to leave
player.fitnessTitle: how fresh his legs are. Below 70% he tires badly in the last quarter
player.sharpnessTitle: match rhythm. A man back from injury is fit but not sharp, and it shows
player.callHimIn: Call him in. {n} conversations left this week.
player.callHimInOne: Call him in. {n} conversation left this week.
player.spokenAlready: You have spoken to him this week already.
player.noConversations: No conversations left this week - the words have to keep their value.
player.praiseTitleGood: tell him his form has been noticed
player.praiseTitleBad: careful: praising a man out of form can read as sarcasm
player.warnTitleGood: a quiet word about his standards
player.warnTitleBad: careful: warning a man in form insults him
player.shownBeside: - his numbers shown beside each bar.
player.retiringTitle: He has announced this season is his last
player.promiseTitle: You made him a promise in the office - keep it or wear it
player.campOpensRest: . A signing bonus or a first-team promise softens the wage.
player.promiseFirstTeam: Promise first-team rugby (a real pledge - he will hold you to it)
player.walkedAway: You walk away from the table. The fee agreement lapses.
player.loanHisLevel: Playing every week and doing his job. Their coaches like him; they also quietly think this is his level.
player.loanFirstName: The first name on their team sheet. Their coach says he is running games at that level.
player.loanGrowing: Growing into it nicely. Good marks most weeks, and the education is clearly taking.
player.loanSteady: Getting the minutes he went for. Steady rather than spectacular.
player.loanRecallNote: He is due back next summer. Recall him early and he returns match-fit, but a cut-short season pays less of the development the loan promised.
player.promotedMsg: {name} joins first-team training. He'll never forget today.
player.marqueeLost: {name} loses marquee status - his wage counts against the cap again.
player.marqueeGiven: {name} designated a marquee player: his wage now sits outside the salary cap ({n} slots left).
player.marqueeGivenOne: {name} designated a marquee player: his wage now sits outside the salary cap ({n} slot left).
player.heIsOn: He is on {wage}/wk until the summer of {year}.
player.campWants: His camp wants {demand}/wk (he is on {wage}). Lowball at your peril.
player.wouldListen: They would listen below the ask, down towards
player.noReasonToSell: No reason to sell cheap: he is wanted, he is playing, and they are under no pressure. It is the asking price or nothing.
player.asLowAs: They may go as low as {floor}.
player.vFirstChoice: a first-choice man at this level
player.vFiller: squad filler who can do a job
player.vFuture: one for the future or the second team
player.vCaveat: on what little you have seen of him
player.vInjured: Out with {desc} for about {n} more weeks.
player.vInjuredOne: Out with {desc} for about {n} more week.
player.vAway: Away with his country, so unavailable to you.
player.vOnLoan: Out on loan for the season.
player.vUnfit: Available but only {pct}% fit, so he will fade.
player.vExpiring: His deal runs out this summer and he can walk for nothing.
player.vWantsOut: A transfer request is on your desk. Minutes would talk him round; nothing else will.
player.vWantsDeal: His agent is asking for improved terms.
player.vUnhappy: He is unhappy, and it will start showing on the pitch.
player.vInForm: In the best form of anyone in the building.
player.vListed: His club have listed him, so a fair offer would be heard.

challenges.sapiacDesc: Tiny Montauban are back in the Elite 14 with the smallest budget in the land. Keep them up. Become immortal in the Tarn-et-Garonne.
challenges.redbullDesc: New owners, big ambitions, bottom-four squad. Turn Newcastle from perennial strugglers into Premier Division champions.
challenges.dynastyDesc: Leinster hoover up every trophy in Ireland. From Thormond Park, end their reign - win the UPC and the Continental Cup.
challenges.piratesDesc: Penzance to the Premier Division: take Cornwall RFC out of the Championship on a shoestring and put the county in the top flight at last.

profile.teamTalkWorth: A team talk is worth {pct}% of its full effect while they feel like this. Win and it climbs; lose and it slides.
profile.drillLonger: Training patterns take {pct}% longer to drill while it lasts.
profile.natOffer: 🌍 {nat} want you as national head coach
profile.natOfferBody: Coach the national side alongside your club. In Test windows you take charge on match day when your club is free - and every championship they win goes in your trophy cabinet.
profile.testWeeksYours: Test weeks are yours when the club calendar allows.
profile.challengeLive: The challenge is live. Judged at each season's end.
profile.decisionsSub: what you chose, and what it did
profile.bareShelves: Bare shelves - for now. Go and fill them.
profile.firstSeason: Your first season is still being written.
profile.specYouthDesc: Trusts the academy and makes kids into men.
profile.specDealerDesc: Lives on the phone. The market bends to him.
profile.specTacticianDesc: Wins the chess match more often than not.
profile.specTacticianHint: Keep a 60% win rate over 20+ matches.
profile.specManmanDesc: Players run through walls for him.
profile.specSurvivorDesc: Boards come and go; he remains.
profile.specMiracleDesc: Won it all with a club nobody backed.
profile.specMiracleHint: Win a league title with an unfancied club.
profile.trustWall: They would run through a wall
profile.trustDisbelief: They do not believe a word
profile.standCarries: Your name carries this room before you say a word.
profile.standFaceValue: The room takes you at face value. Results will do the talking.
profile.standSomeAsk: A few senior heads still ask who you are. Keep winning and they will stop.
profile.standOutranks: The room outranks your record and trains like it knows it.
profile.standNoName: A squad of internationals, a manager without a name: every instruction is quietly re-examined.
